releases.body:
## AutoClip Desktop v1.6.0

### 下载与安装 / Download and install

| 平台 | 文件 | 首次打开 |
|---|---|---|
| macOS 15 及以上（Apple Silicon）| `AutoClip.Desktop_1.6.0_aarch64.dmg` | 双击一次。若被拦截：系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → **仍要打开**（[Apple](https://developer.apple.com/news/?id=saqachfa)） |
| 较旧的 macOS（Apple Silicon）| 同上 | 未公证：右键应用 → **打开** |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `AutoClip.Desktop_1.6.0_x64-setup.exe` | 未签名：SmartScreen → **更多信息 → 仍要运行** |
| CLI / MCP（Python 3.11+）| `autoclip-1.6.0-cli-mcp.zip` / `autoclip_mcp-1.6.0-py3-none-any.whl` | ZIP 内含安装与模型配置说明，需 FFmpeg |

Intel Mac 目前没有桌面安装包，请用 Docker（`DOCKER.md`）或 CLI。Linux 同样没有桌面安装包，请用 Docker、上面的 `uvx`，或 `pip install -e .` 跑 `autoclip` CLI。

两个桌面包都内置便携 Python 与静态 ffmpeg，不需要预装任何东西；Windows 安装包按用户安装，不需要管理员权限，缺 WebView2 会自动下载。
桌面包目前未购置代码签名 / Apple 公证（[#119](https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip/issues/119)），均由公开 GitHub Actions `Desktop Build` 构建；运行前可在附件 `build-provenance.json` 核对安装包 SHA-256（Windows：`Get-FileHash AutoClip.Desktop_1.6.0_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256`；macOS：`shasum -a 256 AutoClip.Desktop_1.6.0_aarch64.dmg`）。
不下载 ZIP 时：`uvx autoclip-mcp` 安装并启动 MCP，`npx skills add zhouxiaoka/autoclip` 安装 skill。从源码安装仍可用（在仓库根目录 `python -m pip install --no-deps .`）。

releases.body:
## AutoClip Desktop v1.5.7

这一版主要让出片更稳，字幕更好看，第一次上手更顺。

This release makes clip generation more reliable, fixes caption display, and smooths out first-time setup.

### 更新了什么

**字幕与风格更好看**
- 长句子不会再被裁掉，会自动分成几屏依次显示；字幕跟着画面一句一句换。
- 制作页可以直接打开或关闭字幕。
- 新增杂志风、街头快剪；成片不再把封面式大标题烧进画面，标题只留在封面图。
- 街头快剪左下人名条会带上公开标题里的嘉宾名（有依据才显示）。
- 杂志风 / 街头快剪的画面叠加更接近选片预览；竖屏取景跟着真正在说话的人。

**第一次用更顺**
- 填好 AI 服务以后马上就能生成，不用刷新页面。
- 设置页空搜索时，推荐服务商把 APIMart 排在第一；也可添加任何 OpenAI 兼容服务。
- 需要下载本地转写时，会提前告诉你要下多大、大概多久，也可以改用云端转写。
- 素材不满足平台要求时（比如 YouTube 横屏要 3 分钟以上），生成前就会提醒你。

**出片更稳**
- 网络抖动或服务繁忙时会自动重试。
- 出错时会用一句中文说清楚原因和怎么办，不再显示看不懂的英文报错。
- 失败的项目可以一键重试。
- 画面理解或封面校对用的模型如果被服务商下架，会按账号当前列表自动换一个还能用的再试。
- Windows 上安装本地转写更快更稳；开着代理也能正常下载成片。

### 下载

AutoClip

Turn any video, link, or live stream into ready-to-post clips.

Open-source, local-first AI clipping for podcasts, interviews, and gaming streams — with smart reframing, captions, covers, and titles built in.


       



Website  ·  Download  ·  Live Replays (v1.6)  ·  Showcase  ·  Quick Start  ·  Docs  ·  Issues

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Português · Русский · Français · Bahasa Indonesia · Türkçe · Tiếng Việt · Deutsch


⭐ Free, MIT-licensed, zero subscriptions — everything cuts and renders on your machine. Star the repo if you find it useful!

Overview

Drop in a link, local video, or live stream replay — AutoClip finds the best moments, tracks the speaker, burns in captions, generates covers, and exports ready-to-post clips for TikTok, Shorts, Reels, YouTube, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and Bilibili.

Local-first by design: cutting and rendering run directly on your computer with no upload queues and no monthly fee. Bring your own API key or run 100% offline with Ollama / LM Studio + Whisper / SenseVoice.

Home → 6 Live Replay sources → OBS WebSocket setup → Twitch import → Finished clip with captions & one-click publish.

What's New in v1.6

Feature Details

OBS Auto-Capture Connect OBS WebSocket (4455), trim losslessly (-c copy), and auto-queue clips right after you end stream.
Game Highlights Generalized highlight detection supporting 8s+ standalone plays with tighter vision/OCR budgets.
One-Click Repurpose Unified playable clip cards — switch target platforms in one click without losing previous exports.

Quick Start

Use case Recommended setup Requirements
Desktop app (easiest) Download .dmg / -setup.exe from Releases Apple Silicon macOS or Windows 10/11 x64 (Python & FFmpeg bundled)
AI agents / CLI / MCP uvx autoclip-mcp or npx skills add zhouxiaoka/autoclip Python 3.10+ (3.11 recommended) & FFmpeg
Self-hosted / Linux / Intel Mac docker compose up -d --build Docker & Compose v2

1. Desktop App

  1. Download the latest installer from GitHub Releases (aarch64.dmg for Apple Silicon macOS, x64-setup.exe for Windows). Portable Python and FFmpeg are bundled.
  2. Open Settings, pick a cloud provider (or start Ollama / LM Studio), test the connection, and save — or click Try the built-in example with no API key.
  3. Paste a video link, drop a file, or switch to Live Replay to connect OBS or import a stream recording. Pick your platforms and click Generate.

Installers are built publicly on GitHub Actions (Desktop Build) with build-provenance.json SHA-256 verification. Code signing and Apple notarization are tracked in #119.

2. CLI & MCP (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode & scripts)

uvx autoclip-mcp
npx skills add zhouxiaoka/autoclip

autoclip --version
autoclip produce talk.mp4 --srt talk.srt --platform tiktok --portrait-style podcast --json
autoclip outputs PROJECT_ID --export-kits
Offline wheel, source install & MCPB packaging 
# Install from a downloaded CLI/MCP release ZIP wheel
python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps autoclip_mcp-*-py3-none-any.whl

# Or install from source
python -m pip install --no-deps .

To build a local MCPB bundle without publishing, run python scripts/pack_mcpb.py (never run smithery mcp publish automatically).

3. Docker / Web

git clone https://github.com/zhouxiaoka/autoclip.git
cd autoclip
cp env.example .env
mkdir -p data logs uploads
docker compose up -d --build

Open the web UI at http://localhost:3000 (API docs at http://localhost:8000/docs). See Docker Guide for bind-mount permissions and custom origins.

Benchmarks

Measured on an Apple Silicon Mac (LLM cost estimated with qwen-plus; excludes cloud ASR and AI image generation; check your provider bill for exact usage):

Input Source Time & Output Est. LLM Cost
With existing subtitles Jensen Huang · 1h 43m (EN → Xiaohongshu) 7.5 min / 10 clips ¥0.09
No subtitles (local Whisper) TIM × Luo Yonghao · 2h 52m (ZH → Douyin) 29.5 min / 10 clips ¥0.20

Sponsor ❤️


APIMart 		Thanks to APIMart for sponsoring AutoClip! APIMart is a low-cost API platform for AI image & video generation — GPT-Image-2 from $0.006/image (160+ images per dollar). One async API covers both image and video: submit a task, get an ID, fetch results via polling or callback. Batch tens of thousands of images without timeouts and switch models without changing code. Pay-as-you-go with no monthly fee — sign up here.

Cloud Transcription (Alibaba Cloud)

Affiliate link (separate from the sponsor above): sign up on Alibaba Cloud, create an API key in the Bailian console, and enable Bailian cloud ASR under Settings → Default models → Speech to subtitles.

  1. Alibaba Cloud signup (affiliate link)
  2. Bailian console — create your API key

FAQ

Is AutoClip free? Do I need an API key?

Yes — AutoClip is free and MIT-licensed. Cloud analysis, transcription, and AI covers use your own API keys at provider rates (local cover layout is free by default). Ollama and LM Studio require no cloud key. Direct publishing uses your own Bilibili or Upload-Post account.

Does my video get uploaded to the cloud?

Cutting and rendering run locally. Cloud analysis only sends transcript text; vision models only receive sampled frames; cloud ASR uploads audio. Running local LLMs + Whisper / SenseVoice keeps everything offline. Analytics and crash reports can be turned off in Settings. See Privacy.

What kind of videos work best?

Podcasts, interviews, talks, courses, and gaming live stream replays (OBS / Twitch / YouTube / Kick / Discord). Sources with existing subtitles are fastest; otherwise use local Whisper / SenseVoice or cloud ASR. For gameplay or low-dialogue streams, enable a vision-capable model.

Why weren't any clips generated?

Check the failed stage: subtitles/transcription, model connection, FFmpeg, disk space, or platform length limits (YouTube long-form requires ≥180s; use Shorts, TikTok, or Bilibili for shorter clips). If it still fails, open an issue with autoclip --version, OS, model, and redacted logs, or check Known Issues (#96).

Troubleshooting · Known Issues

Documentation

Topic Guide
Install & first clips Installation Guide
Self-hosting & agents Docker · CLI & MCP (ZH) · Agent Skill (ZH) · OpenCode
Models & troubleshooting Multi-LLM Setup (ZH) · FAQ
Releases & privacy Changelog · Roadmap (ZH) · Community Board (ZH) · Privacy
Research Pick the Moment, Not the Effect · 中文
Contributing & i18n Contributing (ZH) · Translation Guide (ZH)

Contribute

PRs, bug reports, sample clips, and translations are welcome. If AutoClip saves you time, a ⭐ star helps!

  • Community: GitHub Discussions · First-Clip Q&A · Feature Ideas
  • Bug reports: use the issue template with OS, version, model, repro steps, and redacted logs
  • Partnerships: christine_zhouye@163.com

AutoClip is maintained solo — please expect async replies (no live or 1-on-1 setup support).

Built with FastAPI, React, Tauri, FFmpeg, yt-dlp, Whisper, and FunASR. MIT License.

aiSummary.oneLiner: An AI-powered video processing tool that automatically downloads videos and extracts highlights for content creation.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: AutoClip is an automated video processing system designed to download videos from platforms like YouTube and Bilibili and intelligently extract highlight clips. It utilizes large language models, specifically Qwen, to analyze the video content and identify the most engaging segments. The system automatically cuts the video into smaller clips and can organize them into curated collections. It features a modern React-based frontend and a robust FastAPI backend supported by a Celery task queue for handling asynchronous processing. This pipeline dramatically reduces the manual effort required for secondary video creation and social media clipping.
keyFeatures: Multi-platform downloads: Easily fetch source videos from platforms like YouTube and Bilibili or upload local files.
AI-driven highlights: Uses large language models to analyze content and identify the most compelling moments for clipping.
Automated slicing: Intelligently cuts full-length videos into shorter highlight clips without manual intervention.
Smart collections: Groups generated clips into curated collections with AI recommendations and drag-and-drop sorting.
Asynchronous processing: Relies on a Celery task queue to handle heavy video processing tasks without blocking the UI.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This tool is built for content creators, video editors, and social media managers looking to scale their short-form content production. Users should be familiar with basic Docker or Python setups to deploy the system.
